SetPagefileByPeakUsage.Command: & { function Get-RamFallbackBytes { param([double]$ramBytes) $ramGB = $ramBytes / 1GB; if ($ramGB -le 1) { return [double]1GB }; $extra = [math]::Min($ramGB - 1, 31); $sizeGB = 1 + ($extra / 8); return [double]([math]::Min($sizeGB, 32) * 1GB) }; $computerSystem = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ComputerSystem; $totalPhysicalBytes = [double]$computerSystem.TotalPhysicalMemory; $peakPrivateBytes = (Get-Counter '\Process(_Total)\Page File Bytes Peak').CounterSamples[0].CookedValue; $pageFileInfo = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PageFileUsage -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($pageFileInfo) { $pageFilePath = ($pageFileInfo | Select-Object -First 1).Name } else { $systemDrive = if ($env:SystemDrive) { $env:SystemDrive } else { 'C:' }; $pageFilePath = Join-Path $systemDrive 'pagefile.sys' }; $ramFallbackBytes = Get-RamFallbackBytes -ramBytes $totalPhysicalBytes; $bufferBytes = [double][math]::Max(1GB, $totalPhysicalBytes * 0.1); $excessBytes = $peakPrivateBytes - $totalPhysicalBytes; $recommendedBytes = if ($excessBytes -gt 0) { [double]$excessBytes + $bufferBytes } else { $ramFallbackBytes + $bufferBytes }; $recommendedMB = [int][math]::Ceiling($recommendedBytes / 1MB); $computerSystem.AutomaticManagedPagefile = $false; Set-CimInstance -InputObject $computerSystem | Out-Null; $pageFileSetting = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PageFileSetting -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -ieq $pageFilePath }; if (-not $pageFileSetting) { $pageFileSetting = New-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PageFileSetting -Property @{ Name = $pageFilePath; InitialSize = 0; MaximumSize = 0 } }; $pageFileSetting.InitialSize = $recommendedMB; $pageFileSetting.MaximumSize = $recommendedMB; $pageFileSetting | Set-CimInstance | Out-Null }

DisableHyperVServices.Command: $names=@('Microsoft Hypervisor Service','Microsoft Hyper-V Virtualization Infrastructure Driver'); $found=$false; foreach($n in $names){ $devs=Get-PnpDevice -FriendlyName $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if(-not $devs){ $devs=Get-PnpDevice -FriendlyName ('*{0}*' -f $n) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if($devs){ $found=$true; foreach($d in $devs){ Disable-PnpDevice -InstanceId $d.InstanceId -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }; if(-not $found){ throw 'No matching Hyper-V related devices found.' }

EnableHyperVServices.Command: $names=@('Microsoft Hypervisor Service','Microsoft Hyper-V Virtualization Infrastructure Driver'); $found=$false; foreach($n in $names){ $devs=Get-PnpDevice -FriendlyName $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if(-not $devs){ $devs=Get-PnpDevice -FriendlyName ('*{0}*' -f $n) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if($devs){ $found=$true; foreach($d in $devs){ Enable-PnpDevice -InstanceId $d.InstanceId -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }; if(-not $found){ throw 'No matching Hyper-V related devices found.' }

RemoveWindowsOld.Command: $dest="$home\Desktop";$bat="$home\Desktop\Taskband.bat";$ms="$env:APPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\Recent\AutomaticDestinations\f01b4d95cf55d32a.automaticDestinations-ms";if(Test-Path $ms){Copy-Item $ms -Destination $dest -Force};$tb="$env:APPDATA\Microsoft\Internet Explorer\Quick Launch\User Pinned\TaskBar";$tbdes=Join-Path $dest "TaskBar";Remove-Item $tbdes -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;if(Test-Path $tb){Copy-Item $tb -Destination $tbdes -Recurse -Force};$hex=((Get-ItemProperty "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Taskband" -Name "Favorites").Favorites|ForEach-Object {'{0:X2}' -f $_}) -join '';$hexnis=((Get-ItemProperty "HKCU:\Control Panel\NotifyIconSettings" -Name "UIOrderList").UIOrderList|ForEach-Object {'{0:X2}' -f $_}) -join '';$q=[char]34;$lines=@("@echo off","",("reg add "+$q+"HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Taskband"+$q+" /v Favorites /t REG_BINARY /d "+$hex+" /f"),("reg add "+$q+"HKCU\Control Panel\NotifyIconSettings"+$q+" /v UIOrderList /t REG_BINARY /d "+$hexnis+" /f"));Set-Content -Path $bat -Value $lines
